relationships.subject: EZH2
relationships.evidence_quote: high EZH2 promotes disease progression and is a potential therapeutic target

relationships.subject: DOT1L
relationships.evidence_quote: DOT1L exerts protective effects, partly by suppressing Wnt signaling

key_findings: EZH2 and DOT1L have opposing roles in OA: high EZH2 promotes progression whereas DOT1L is protective via Wnt suppression.
Targeting BRD4, PCAF and HDAC1/2 shows therapeutic potential in preclinical OA models.
